positive_snippets: All staffs were good and well educated and know how to talk. Neat/ Clean rooms.
I had an excellent experience at this hotel, the check in process was smooth and efficient, the room was comfortable and clean. Highly recommended.
negative_snippets: They denied your booking upfront and refused to provide you a room, stating they do not accept online bookings. If that's the case, why do they list their property on websites? They should take responsibility for coordinating their listings with these sites. They should either not list their property or provide the services advertised, so customers don't have to suffer mentally and physically, especially in the summer with their luggage. Not recommended at all.
